text_blocks.snippet: The One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA), a massive tax and spending bill, was recently signed into law by President Trump. It includes significant tax cuts, changes to Medicaid, and increased spending on border security and defense. The bill is projected to increase the national debt by trillions of dollars and is expected to have a modest positive impact on the economy.

list.title: Tax Cuts:
list.snippet: The bill includes significant tax cuts, including a no tax on tips for workers and changes to clean energy tax credits. It also includes a new deduction for individuals aged 65 and older.

list.title: Medicaid Changes:
list.snippet: The bill introduces work requirements for able-bodied adults to qualify for Medicaid benefits and caps the taxes states can impose on Medicaid providers, with a gradual reduction.

list.title: Increased Spending:
list.snippet: The bill increases government spending on border security, missile defense, and other areas. It also includes a new fund for rural hospitals.

list.title: Impact on Debt:
list.snippet: The Congressional Budget Office (CBO) estimates the bill will increase borrowing by $4.1 trillion through 2034. The Tax Policy Center estimates the bill will increase federal debt by $4.5 trillion by 2034.

list.title: Economic Impact:
list.snippet: The Tax Foundation estimates the bill will increase long-run GDP by 1.2 percent.
The bill is a centerpiece of President Trump's domestic agenda.
It was passed by the House of Representatives and the Senate, with Vice President Vance casting a tie-breaking vote in the Senate.
The bill was signed into law on July 4th.
Republicans have already discussed potential changes to the law.
